subject: Post-discovery: 30-min Redwood demo — scheduling options
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@enterprisefin.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@enterprisefin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min Redwood demo — scheduling options

Hi Jamie & Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the time and the clarity on EnterpriseFin's priorities (fraud detection latency and embedding search cost). Quick recap: you want a 30-minute intro demo focused on Redwood's hosted API + routing/fallback and a short discussion of Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput. Marcus (cc'd) would handle the technical deep dive.

Proposed 30-min demo slots (all US Pacific):
- Option A: Wed 21 Oct — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Option B: Thu 22 Oct — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Option C: Fri 23 Oct — 09:30–10:00 PT

Who should join from your side? Based on the discovery, recommended stakeholders: product manager (Priya?), infra/ops lead, and 1-2 folks owning ML infra. I can hold two slots and send a calendar invite once you confirm preferred time and attendees.

Attached is a short agenda for the 30-min intro to set expectations.

Next steps: pick an option (or send two times that work) and I’ll lock the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0139

Attachments: MVP_demo_agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@enterprisefin.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: 30-min Redwood demo — scheduling options

Thanks Vanessa — great recap. Option A (Wed 21 Oct 10:00 PT) works for me. Priya is out Wed afternoon but can do Option C on Fri morning.

If we do Wed, attendees confirmed so far: Jamie (me), Alex Chen (Infra Lead, alex.chen@enterprisefin.com). I'll confirm Priya and our ML lead tomorrow morning.

Also, can you include a 5–10 minute section on security/compliance (SOC2 / data retention) since we'll need to share with our security team?

—Jamie
Head of Platform — EnterpriseFin
jamie.lowe@enterprisefin.com

Vanessa — thanks for looping me in. I’ll prepare a 10–12 minute technical segment covering:
- Routing policies (latency vs cost) and example policy configs
- Fallback model variants and graceful degradation behavior
- Dedicated pool sizing guidance for 99th percentile latency targets

I’ll attach a short slide with the example config and a couple of perf numbers we can reference live. Also happy to jump on the security portion if Priya’s team has technical questions.

Marcus
